note: “What it builds” for each of the 45 drills, shown on the Go deeper page. New writing drafted from the rule cards for Mark to edit; NOT book text and not quoted as such. Keys match drills.five_minute / drills.uncomfortable / drills.daily in bb-rule-cards.json.

rules.five_minute: Breaks the stall. One small, visible step proves you can move without the full plan, and that proof makes the next step easier.
rules.uncomfortable: Puts a date on it in front of witnesses. A public commitment turns “someday” into a deadline, and deadlines beat good intentions.
rules.daily: Builds a shipping habit. Imperfect work out the door before noon, every day, stacks into a body of work and starves perfectionism.

rules.five_minute: Gets the truth out of your head and into words. Saying it out loud shrinks it and shows you exactly what you’ve been avoiding.
rules.uncomfortable: Stops the damage from compounding. Owning it the same day keeps a problem a problem instead of a crisis, and earns trust most people never get.
rules.daily: Makes honesty routine instead of an event. Small truths cleared early mean fewer big, ugly ones later.

rules.five_minute: Teaches your body that hard is survivable. One rep that burns resets what you think you can handle.
rules.uncomfortable: Finds your real limit on purpose, on a schedule. Failing in practice is how you stop failing when it counts.
rules.daily: Compounds capacity. One more rep or one percent more every day is quiet and boring, and over a year it’s unbeatable.

rules.five_minute: Turns an ordinary day into one you showed up ready for. Three bullets of prep is the difference between reacting and performing.
rules.uncomfortable: Builds the nerve to act first. Going first when it matters gets easier every time, and people notice who moves.
rules.daily: Makes every day a lesson. Reviewing wins, fixes and the next rep turns experience into improvement instead of time served.

rules.five_minute: A fast reset for body and head. Water and movement are the cheapest energy you’ll ever buy.
rules.uncomfortable: Shows you what one habit has been costing you. Seven days without it is long enough to feel the difference and decide on evidence.
rules.daily: Builds the foundation everything else runs on. Consistent sleep means more energy, better decisions and a longer fuse.

rules.five_minute: Gives you something to point to. Proof of value beats a promise of potential.
rules.uncomfortable: Changes the conversation from asking to offering. Leading with work you’ve already done makes yes the easy answer.
rules.daily: Builds leverage. Every reusable asset keeps working after you stop, and together they add up to something you own.

rules.five_minute: Turns irritation into information. One written lesson means today’s frustration paid for something.
rules.uncomfortable: Proves failure isn’t final. Going back with one change is how a setback becomes a skill.
rules.daily: Builds the habit of converting bad days into something useful. Over time you start looking for the lesson instead of fearing the pain.

rules.five_minute: Gives you a filter. Written non-negotiables make big decisions faster and second-guessing quieter.
rules.uncomfortable: Frees your time for what fits. Every misaligned yes you decline makes room for one that matters.
rules.daily: Builds a life that looks like you. Small choices for values over vibes add up until you don’t need the costume.

rules.five_minute: Steadies you before the day starts pulling. A minute of stillness and purpose sets the anchor.
rules.uncomfortable: Makes your values visible. Holding a boundary out loud tells people who you are and makes the next one easier.
rules.daily: Trains you to notice provision. A written record of answered effort is fuel for the days doubt shows up.

rules.five_minute: Shows you where to point your effort. The overlap of what you’re good at, care about and get paid for is where work stops feeling like work.
rules.uncomfortable: Gets it out of your head and into the world. Shipping something you’d do for free tells you fast whether the obsession is real.
rules.daily: Keeps the fire fed. A little every day in the space you love compounds into skill, connections and chances the paycheck chasers never see.

rules.five_minute: Gives you a filter for who you build with. Knowing what you need makes the wrong fit obvious sooner.
rules.uncomfortable: Clears room for the right people. Ending one obligation relationship frees time and energy for someone who’s actually aligned.
rules.daily: Builds a team that tells each other the truth. Kind, direct feedback every day prevents the slow rot of things left unsaid.

rules.five_minute: Strengthens a relationship in three lines. Specific thanks lands harder than generic praise and costs you five minutes.
rules.uncomfortable: Repairs what pride broke. An apology without excuses earns respect that defending yourself never will.
rules.daily: Makes kindness a reflex. Solving one small friction for someone every day changes how people experience you.

rules.five_minute: Makes the standard clear. One sentence everyone understands beats a lecture nobody remembers.
rules.uncomfortable: Shows your standards are real. A boundary held calmly and consistently teaches more than any speech.
rules.daily: Balances weight with warmth. Daily moments of teaching and praise make standards feel like love, not control.

rules.five_minute: Turns a standard into a system. Trigger, action, track is what makes “I should” actually happen.
rules.uncomfortable: Raises the floor. Cutting one lazy shortcut for good lifts everything that runs through that process.
rules.daily: Catches mistakes before they happen. Checking first builds confidence you earned, not confidence you’re faking.

rules.five_minute: Reminds you who’s watching. Naming them makes your choices about more than you.
rules.uncomfortable: Opens a door for someone younger. One real conversation about the future can change the direction of a life.
rules.daily: Makes your example the lesson. Doing the hard thing where others can see it teaches more than anything you could tell them.
